Al-Adsani v. United Kingdom (2001): the Grand Chamber held, 9–8, that the UK's grant of state immunity to Kuwait did not violate Article 6. Immunity prevailed over the claimed right of access to a court, even though the alleged torture was a jus cogens violation. Of the two options the team note leaves, B fits: immunity trumped the right to a fair trial. D is the opposite of what the Court held.

CONFIDENCE: 90
